input.quote: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
input.rationale: The three-year term (§ 8.1) contains no Customer termination-for-convenience right: Section 9 gives only for-cause, insolvency and security/SLA/legal-violation rights, and § 2.1 expressly commits Customer on a take-or-pay basis "without reduction or termination rights". Section 8.2 non-renewal is a natural-term right (RENEWAL) and § 27.3 is a force-majeure exit, so neither substitutes. Section 10.2's refund of "prepaid recurring Fees covering the period after termination" is not expressly pro rata and excludes prepaid non-recurring Fees, so it does not satisfy the refund element. We therefore add a new § 9.4 giving Customer a 30 days' notice convenience right with a pro-rata refund of all prepaid Fees for the post-termination period and barring Vendor convenience termination during a committed term, and conform § 2.1 while preserving the no-reduction restriction.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.summary: Add a Customer 30-day convenience termination right with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees, bar Vendor convenience termination, and conform the take-or-pay clause.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need a customer termination-for-convenience right in a three-year committed term, so we have added a 30 days' notice right with a pro-rata refund of all prepaid Fees for the post-termination period and confirmed Vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. We have also conformed Section 2.1 so the take-or-pay commitment no longer negates that termination right, while leaving the no-reduction restriction intact.

ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon thirty days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund, on a pro-rata basis, all prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

ops.oldText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction rights but subject to Customer's termination rights.
